leaf.text: AMD's Platform QoS (PQoS) is equivalent to Intel's Resource Director Technology (RDT). For CAT L2/L3, AMD maintains enumeration compatibility with Intel through CPUID 0x10. For MBA/SMBA, AMD CPUs declare this extended leaf instead. AMD's Memory Bandwidth Enforcement (MBE) closely aligns with Intel's MBA. Thus, for simplification, this document defaults to Intel's naming conventions.
